plugins.name: cm-workspace
plugins.description: Change-management working tools. Three skills: an RFP-to-proposal deck generator that plans a bid against the client's stated requirements and evaluation criteria; a communications generator that drafts change comms for a requested channel and routes each to the tool that builds it — Word for emails and articles, PowerPoint for briefing decks, Canva for newsletters and banners, and production specs for video; and a status-update agent that diffs this period's programme documents against last period's and drafts the cadence-meeting update, with every claim traced to a specific change. All three write from a shared curated knowledge bank where applicable and audit their output for coverage and content provenance before anything is produced.
